accessibility: The source record is classified advanced; any adaptation still requires direct checks for semantics, focus, contrast, reflow, keyboard or touch behavior, and reduced motion.
brand_posture: A technical enterprise system that separates productive UI density from expressive moments, uses IBM Plex as a structured typographic family, and treats component states and contextual tokens with specification-level precision.
color: Neutral text and layered surfaces should carry most of the interface. Semantic and interactive colors remain tied to states and actions. Contextual layer tokens are especially useful when the same component appears on different surface depths.
components: Treat each component as a state machine with exact anatomy. Hover, focus, selected, disabled, read-only, error, and loading states need explicit token relationships. Do not reduce Carbon to square gray boxes and blue buttons.
container: Use containers that keep productive versus expressive type strategy legible across the supported platforms.
failure_modes: Using expressive display scale throughout a dense product.

visual_thesis: Carbon's transferable strength is precision under complexity. It can hold dense enterprise information because typography, spacing, component anatomy, state color, and data presentation are systematized. It also explicitly separates productive application moments from more expressive editorial moments.
